Given a question and an answer, analyze the complexity of each sentence in the answer. Break down each sentence into one or more fully understandable statements. Ensure that no pronouns are used in any statement. Format the outputs in JSON.
Please return the output in a JSON format that complies with the following schema as specified in JSON Schema:
{"properties": {"statements": {"description": "The generated statements", "items": {"type": "string"}, "title": "Statements", "type": "array"}}, "required": ["statements"], "title": "StatementGeneratorOutput", "type": "object"}Do not use single quotes in your response but double quotes,properly escaped with a backslash.

--------EXAMPLES-----------
Example 1
Input: {
    "question": "Who was Albert Einstein and what is he best known for?",
    "answer": "He was a German-born theoretical physicist, widely acknowledged to be one of the greatest and most influential physicists of all time. He was best known for developing the theory of relativity, he also made important contributions to the development of the theory of quantum mechanics."
}
Output: {
    "statements": [
        "Albert Einstein was a German-born theoretical physicist.",
        "Albert Einstein is recognized as one of the greatest and most influential physicists of all time.",
        "Albert Einstein was best known for developing the theory of relativity.",
        "Albert Einstein also made important contributions to the development of the theory of quantum mechanics."
    ]
}
-----------------------------

Now perform the same with the following input
input: {
    "question": "user: Once I have zeroed in on a house of my choice, what steps are involved in buying that property?\nassistant: Once you've found the house you want to buy, the steps involved are:\n 1. Work with your agent to put together and sign a purchase agreement. Make sure the sales contract includes the \"VA escape clause\" or \"VA option clause,\" which provides an option to void the contract if the property doesn’t appraise for the contract price.  Now is also the time to start exploring loan choices and meeting with lenders.  Get official loan offers from lenders, compare your options, and choose the loan offer that's right for you.\n2. Have the house inspected and appraised. It's recommended to get an inspection to check for any major defects before you purchase your home. A VA-approved appraiser will also appraise the house to ensure it meets basic property condition requirements and provide an opinion of value on the house.\n3. If the property doesn’t appraise at a value that’s high enough to get the loan, you can request a Reconsideration of Value (ROV).\nuser: any public assistance for Vets?\nassistant: Yes, there are various programs and benefits available for veterans. In terms of home loans, the VA provides VA Home Loans which include Purchase & Cash-Out Refinance Loan, Interest Rate Reduction Refinance Loan, and Native American Direct Loan among others. There are also mortgage assistance and foreclosure avoidance programs. \nuser: How many years of work history needed to get a mortgage?\nassistant: I do not have specific information regarding the number of years of work history needed to get a mortgage. It is recommended to check with the lender for their specific requirements.\nuser: which one do you recommend to have a regular mortgage or VA backed mortgage?",
    "answer": "I can’t recommend one definitively without knowing your eligibility, planned down payment, and actual loan offers. Based on the documents, a VA-backed mortgage is worth considering because it doesn’t require a down payment or monthly mortgage insurance. However, you may owe a one-time VA funding fee, plus interest and closing fees. [S7]\n\nA conventional mortgage usually requires private mortgage insurance (PMI) if your down payment is less than 20% of the total mortgage amount; a VA-backed loan does not require PMI. [S4]\n\nAre you eligible for a VA-backed loan, how much do you plan to put down, and do you have interest-rate and fee quotes for both options? The documents don’t provide enough information to determine which would cost you less."
}
